verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.openai.com that indexes Plugins docs, and a plugin-specific llms.txt also exists (developers.openai.com/plugins/llms.txt). Docs are served as Markdown (.md) pages that point back to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be aimed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and first-party guidance on how to point an agent at them.
